subject.title: fix(discord): pass session file to plugin slash commands

question: Should Discord plugin slash commands be revised to use the transcript resolver before this PR can merge, or may the direct session-store/file-path path be accepted as a temporary exception?
rationale: The central behavior is useful, but accepting direct `sessions.json` and transcript file-path access would set a compatibility-sensitive exception during an active storage migration.

options.title: Use the transcript resolver
options.body: Revise the PR to use `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget`, matching Telegram and avoiding a new direct legacy storage path.

options.title: Accept a temporary exception
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly allow the direct helper calls if they want this Discord path exempted from the accessor migration for now.

options.title: Keep paused for proof
options.body: Leave the draft blocked until the contributor provides live Discord proof and updates the implementation.

recommendation.title: Use the transcript resolver
recommendation.body: Revise the PR to use `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget`, matching Telegram and avoiding a new direct legacy storage path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent session/transcript accessor migration history that determines whether this storage exception is acceptable.
